findings.whyThisIsNotPedantry: CLAUDE-PTLJ-V3-SF1 was itself a finding that this lineage misstates its own custody in the fields that record custody, sustained on the ground that a consumer keying on those fields would be misled. The subject's disposition of that finding now misnames the artifact that discharged it, and does so in the only field a later reader would consult to learn where the repair entered the lineage. Recording v6 as the landing site also writes v5 out of the repair history at the same time as predecessorV5.role reduces v5 to a stale historical measurement — so the error is self-reinforcing rather than isolated, and it will carry into v8 the way the 'does not reuse' sentences carried from v2 into v4.
whyNotABlockerOrMustFix: No measurement is corrupted. All 26 inline pairs, all 26 recordedInputs entries and file08Pin measure equal; zero mismatches.
The landed state itself is correct and unchanged: artifact v7, version 7, and both predecessor roles in the repaired generic form. Nothing is re-landed, which is what the dispatch protects.
